nodes.title: About Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.
生成一个真人手，食指指着图片人物酒窝

Starting from the left keyframe, a first-person perspective frames a chibi anime girl with long pastel pink hair tied in a high ponytail, adorned with light blue crescent-shaped accessories and a wing-shaped hair clip, wearing a white and teal fantasy outfit with a heart-shaped gem on her chest, her eyes closed in a soft smile as a real human hand approaches her face, the plain white background keeping focus on the interaction. The scene comes alive in continuous motion: the real hand moves slowly toward the girl’s hair, fingers brushing gently against the soft pink strands to tease and tousle them, the anime girl’s cheeks flushing pink, her ears twitching slightly, her lips curving into a shyer, more delighted smile, her closed eyes crinkling at the corners as she reacts to the touch. Then the hand lifts slightly to pat the top of her head gently, the girl’s head tilting slightly into the touch, her hair swaying with the movement, her expression shifting to a more playful, happy grin, her cheeks puffing out slightly in shyness, tiny sparkles appearing around her head to emphasize her joyful mood. The camera remains steady, capturing the smooth, fluid motion of the hand and the anime girl’s responsive facial expressions and subtle body movements, maintaining seamless interaction continuity, vibrant anime cel-shading style, soft cel-shaded lighting, clean line art, warm and cute atmosphere, and hyper-realistic hand textures contrasting with the anime character’s stylized design throughout the 8-second sequence, ending with the girl leaning into the hand’s touch, her eyes still closed in a contented, shy smile, the hand resting lightly on her head.
